notes: Reworked: striped brick (white stone course every ~1.1 m plus window bands), pale-stone ground storey, semicircular south bay (circle fitted to ring vertices 94-118, centre 11.30/13.34, R 5.9 m) with glazed white terrace pavilion, balcony, three window axes x four floors and three gables, stone-framed dormers on the Amstel and Doelenstraat mansards, vertical stone piers between axes (3.0 m pitch), copper-capped corner turret. Not modelled: the exact stepped gable shapes and ornamental stone brackets, balcony variety, turret oriel. The NE side (35 m, bearing 58) is a genuine party wall and the only partyWallBearings entry.
